title: Writing addons in various programming languages
Working with JavaScript values and abstract operations
napi_set_instance_data
description: This API associates data with the currently running Node.js environment. data can later be retrieved using napi_get_instance_data().

title: napi_get_instance_data
description: This API retrieves data that was previously associated with the currently running Node.js environment via napi_set_instance_data(). If no data is set, the call will succeed and data will be set to NULL.

title: napi_status
description: Integral status code indicating the success or failure of a Node-API call. Currently, the following status codes are supported.

title: napi_extended_error_info
description: See the Error handling section for additional information.

title: napi_env
description: napi_env is used to represent a context that the underlying Node-API implementation can use to persist VM-specific state.

title: node_api_basic_env
description: This variant of napi_env is passed to synchronous finalizers (node_api_basic_finalize). There is a subset of Node-APIs which accept a parameter of type node_api_basic_env as their first argument.

title: napi_value
description: This is an opaque pointer that is used to represent a JavaScript value.

title: napi_threadsafe_function
description: This is an opaque pointer that represents a JavaScript function which can be called asynchronously from multiple threads via napi_call_threadsafe_function().

title: napi_threadsafe_function_release_mode
description: A value to be given to napi_release_threadsafe_function() to indicate whether the thread-safe function is to be closed immediately (napi_tsfn_abort) or merely released (napi_tsfn_release) and thus available for…

title: napi_threadsafe_function_call_mode
description: A value to be given to napi_call_threadsafe_function() to indicate whether the call should block whenever the queue associated with the thread-safe function is full.

title: napi_handle_scope
description: This is an abstraction used to control and modify the lifetime of objects created within a particular scope. In general, Node-API values are created within the context of a handle scope.

title: napi_escapable_handle_scope
description: Escapable handle scopes are a special type of handle scope to return values created within a particular handle scope to a parent scope.

title: napi_ref
description: This is the abstraction to use to reference a napi_value. This allows for users to manage the lifetimes of JavaScript values, including defining their minimum lifetimes explicitly.

title: napi_type_tag
description: A 128-bit value stored as two unsigned 64-bit integers. It serves as a UUID with which JavaScript objects or externals can be "tagged" in order to ensure that they are of a certain type.

title: napi_async_cleanup_hook_handle
description: An opaque value returned by napi_add_async_cleanup_hook. It must be passed to napi_remove_async_cleanup_hook when the chain of asynchronous cleanup events completes.

title: napi_callback_info
description: Opaque datatype that is passed to a callback function. It can be used for getting additional information about the context in which the callback was invoked.

title: napi_callback
description: Function pointer type for user-provided native functions which are to be exposed to JavaScript via Node-API. Callback functions should satisfy the following signature:

title: node_api_basic_finalize
description: Function pointer type for add-on provided functions that allow the user to be notified when externally-owned data is ready to be cleaned up because the object it was associated with has been garbage-collected.

title: napi_finalize
description: Function pointer type for add-on provided function that allow the user to schedule a group of calls to Node-APIs in response to a garbage collection event, after the garbage collection cycle has completed.

title: napi_async_execute_callback
description: Function pointer used with functions that support asynchronous operations. Callback functions must satisfy the following signature:

title: napi_async_complete_callback
description: Function pointer used with functions that support asynchronous operations. Callback functions must satisfy the following signature:

title: napi_threadsafe_function_call_js
description: Function pointer used with asynchronous thread-safe function calls. The callback will be called on the main thread.

title: napi_cleanup_hook
description: Function pointer used with napi_add_env_cleanup_hook. It will be called when the environment is being torn down.

title: napi_async_cleanup_hook
description: Function pointer used with napi_add_async_cleanup_hook. It will be called when the environment is being torn down.

title: napi_get_last_error_info
description: This API retrieves a napi_extended_error_info structure with information about the last error that occurred.

title: napi_throw
description: This API throws the JavaScript value provided.

title: napi_throw_error
description: This API throws a JavaScript Error with the text provided.

title: napi_throw_type_error
description: This API throws a JavaScript TypeError with the text provided.

title: napi_throw_range_error
description: This API throws a JavaScript RangeError with the text provided.

title: node_api_throw_syntax_error
description: This API throws a JavaScript SyntaxError with the text provided.

title: napi_is_error
description: This API queries a napi_value to check if it represents an error object.

title: napi_create_error
description: This API returns a JavaScript Error with the text provided.

title: napi_create_type_error
description: This API returns a JavaScript TypeError with the text provided.

title: napi_create_range_error
description: This API returns a JavaScript RangeError with the text provided.

title: node_api_create_syntax_error
description: This API returns a JavaScript SyntaxError with the text provided.

title: napi_get_and_clear_last_exception
description: This API can be called even if there is a pending JavaScript exception.

title: napi_is_exception_pending
description: This API can be called even if there is a pending JavaScript exception.

title: napi_fatal_exception
description: Trigger an 'uncaughtException' in JavaScript. Useful if an async callback throws an exception with no way to recover.

title: napi_fatal_error
description: The function call does not return, the process will be terminated.

title: napi_open_handle_scope
description: This API opens a new scope.

title: napi_close_handle_scope
description: This API closes the scope passed in. Scopes must be closed in the reverse order from which they were created.

title: napi_open_escapable_handle_scope
description: This API opens a new scope from which one object can be promoted to the outer scope.

title: napi_close_escapable_handle_scope
description: This API closes the scope passed in. Scopes must be closed in the reverse order from which they were created.

title: napi_escape_handle
description: This API promotes the handle to the JavaScript object so that it is valid for the lifetime of the outer scope. It can only be called once per scope. If it is called more than once an error will be returned.

title: napi_create_reference
description: This API creates a new reference with the specified reference count to the value passed in.

title: napi_delete_reference
description: This API deletes the reference passed in.

title: napi_reference_ref
description: This API increments the reference count for the reference passed in and returns the resulting reference count.

title: napi_reference_unref
description: This API decrements the reference count for the reference passed in and returns the resulting reference count.

title: napi_get_reference_value
description: If still valid, this API returns the napi_value representing the JavaScript value associated with the napi_ref. Otherwise, result will be NULL.

title: napi_add_env_cleanup_hook
description: Registers fun as a function to be run with the arg parameter once the current Node.js environment exits.

title: napi_remove_env_cleanup_hook
description: Unregisters fun as a function to be run with the arg parameter once the current Node.js environment exits. Both the argument and the function value need to be exact matches.

title: napi_add_async_cleanup_hook
description: Registers hook, which is a function of type napi_async_cleanup_hook, as a function to be run with the remove_handle and arg parameters once the current Node.js environment exits.

title: napi_remove_async_cleanup_hook
description: Unregisters the cleanup hook corresponding to remove_handle. This will prevent the hook from being executed, unless it has already started executing.

title: napi_key_collection_mode
description: Describes the Keys/Properties filter enums:

title: napi_key_filter
description: Property filter bit flag. This works with bit operators to build a composite filter.

title: napi_key_conversion
description: napi_key_numbers_to_strings will convert integer indexes to strings. napi_key_keep_numbers will return numbers for integer indexes.

title: napi_valuetype
description: Describes the type of a napi_value. This generally corresponds to the types described in Section language types of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_typedarray_type
description: This represents the underlying binary scalar datatype of the TypedArray. Elements of this enum correspond to Section TypedArray objects of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_create_array
description: This API returns a Node-API value corresponding to a JavaScript Array type. JavaScript arrays are described in Section Array objects of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_create_array_with_length
description: This API returns a Node-API value corresponding to a JavaScript Array type. The Array's length property is set to the passed-in length parameter.

title: napi_create_arraybuffer
description: This API returns a Node-API value corresponding to a JavaScript ArrayBuffer. ArrayBuffers are used to represent fixed-length binary data buffers. They are normally used as a backing-buffer for TypedArray objects.

title: napi_create_buffer
description: This API allocates a node::Buffer object. While this is still a fully-supported data structure, in most cases using a TypedArray will suffice.

title: napi_create_buffer_copy
description: This API allocates a node::Buffer object and initializes it with data copied from the passed-in buffer. While this is still a fully-supported data structure, in most cases using a TypedArray will suffice.

title: napi_create_date
description: This API does not observe leap seconds; they are ignored, as ECMAScript aligns with POSIX time specification.

title: napi_create_external
description: This API allocates a JavaScript value with external data attached to it. This is used to pass external data through JavaScript code, so it can be retrieved later by native code using napi_get_value_external.

title: napi_create_external_arraybuffer
description: In order to maintain broadest compatibility with all runtimes you may define NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED in your addon before includes for the node-api headers.

title: node_api_create_external_sharedarraybuffer
description: Create a SharedArrayBuffer with externally managed memory.

title: napi_create_external_buffer
description: In order to maintain broadest compatibility with all runtimes you may define NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED in your addon before includes for the node-api headers.

title: napi_create_object
description: This API allocates a default JavaScript Object. It is the equivalent of doing new Object() in JavaScript.

title: node_api_create_object_with_properties
description: This API creates a JavaScript Object with the specified prototype and properties.

title: napi_create_symbol
description: This API creates a JavaScript symbol value from a UTF8-encoded C string.

title: node_api_symbol_for
description: This API searches in the global registry for an existing symbol with the given description. If the symbol already exists it will be returned, otherwise a new symbol will be created in the registry.

title: napi_create_typedarray
description: This API creates a JavaScript TypedArray object over an existing ArrayBuffer or SharedArrayBuffer.

title: node_api_create_buffer_from_arraybuffer
description: This API creates a JavaScript Buffer object from an existing ArrayBuffer. The Buffer object is a Node.js-specific class that provides a way to work with binary data directly in JavaScript.

title: napi_create_dataview
description: This API creates a JavaScript DataView object over an existing ArrayBuffer or SharedArrayBuffer.

title: napi_create_int32
description: This API is used to convert from the C int32_t type to the JavaScript number type.

title: napi_create_uint32
description: This API is used to convert from the C uint32_t type to the JavaScript number type.

title: napi_create_int64
description: This API is used to convert from the C int64_t type to the JavaScript number type.

title: napi_create_double
description: This API is used to convert from the C double type to the JavaScript number type.

title: napi_create_bigint_int64
description: This API converts the C int64_t type to the JavaScript BigInt type.

title: napi_create_bigint_uint64
description: This API converts the C uint64_t type to the JavaScript BigInt type.

title: napi_create_bigint_words
description: This API converts an array of unsigned 64-bit words into a single BigInt value.

title: napi_create_string_latin1
description: This API creates a JavaScript string value from an ISO-8859-1-encoded C string. The native string is copied.

title: node_api_create_external_string_latin1
description: This API creates a JavaScript string value from an ISO-8859-1-encoded C string. The native string may not be copied and must thus exist for the entire life cycle of the JavaScript value.

title: napi_create_string_utf16
description: This API creates a JavaScript string value from a UTF16-LE-encoded C string. The native string is copied.

title: node_api_create_external_string_utf16
description: This API creates a JavaScript string value from a UTF16-LE-encoded C string. The native string may not be copied and must thus exist for the entire life cycle of the JavaScript value.

title: napi_create_string_utf8
description: This API creates a JavaScript string value from a UTF8-encoded C string. The native string is copied.

title: node_api_create_property_key_latin1
description: This API creates an optimized JavaScript string value from an ISO-8859-1-encoded C string to be used as a property key for objects. The native string is copied.

title: node_api_create_property_key_utf16
description: This API creates an optimized JavaScript string value from a UTF16-LE-encoded C string to be used as a property key for objects. The native string is copied.

title: node_api_create_property_key_utf8
description: This API creates an optimized JavaScript string value from a UTF8-encoded C string to be used as a property key for objects. The native string is copied.

title: napi_get_array_length
description: This API returns the length of an array.

title: napi_get_arraybuffer_info
description: This API is used to retrieve the underlying data buffer of an ArrayBuffer or SharedArrayBuffer and its length.

title: napi_get_buffer_info
description: This method returns the identical data and byte_length as napi_get_typedarray_info. And napi_get_typedarray_info accepts a node::Buffer (a Uint8Array) as the value too.

title: napi_get_typedarray_info
description: This API returns various properties of a typed array.

title: napi_get_dataview_info
description: Any of the out parameters may be NULL if that property is unneeded.

title: napi_get_date_value
description: This API does not observe leap seconds; they are ignored, as ECMAScript aligns with POSIX time specification.

title: napi_get_value_bool
description: This API returns the C boolean primitive equivalent of the given JavaScript Boolean.

title: napi_get_value_double
description: This API returns the C double primitive equivalent of the given JavaScript number.

title: napi_get_value_bigint_int64
description: This API returns the C int64_t primitive equivalent of the given JavaScript BigInt. If needed it will truncate the value, setting lossless to false.

title: napi_get_value_bigint_uint64
description: This API returns the C uint64_t primitive equivalent of the given JavaScript BigInt. If needed it will truncate the value, setting lossless to false.

title: napi_get_value_bigint_words
description: This API converts a single BigInt value into a sign bit, 64-bit little-endian array, and the number of elements in the array. sign_bit and words may be both set to NULL, in order to get only word_count.

title: napi_get_value_external
description: This API retrieves the external data pointer that was previously passed to napi_create_external().

title: napi_get_value_int32
description: This API returns the C int32 primitive equivalent of the given JavaScript number.

title: napi_get_value_int64
description: This API returns the C int64 primitive equivalent of the given JavaScript number.

title: napi_get_value_string_latin1
description: This API returns the ISO-8859-1-encoded string corresponding the value passed in.

title: napi_get_value_string_utf8
description: This API returns the UTF8-encoded string corresponding the value passed in.

title: napi_get_value_string_utf16
description: This API returns the UTF16-encoded string corresponding the value passed in.

title: napi_get_value_uint32
description: This API returns the C primitive equivalent of the given napi_value as a uint32_t.

title: napi_get_boolean
description: This API is used to return the JavaScript singleton object that is used to represent the given boolean value.

title: napi_get_global
description: This API returns the global object.

title: napi_get_null
description: This API returns the null object.

title: napi_get_undefined
description: This API returns the Undefined object.

title: napi_coerce_to_bool
description: This API implements the abstract operation ToBoolean() as defined in Section ToBoolean of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_coerce_to_number
description: This API implements the abstract operation ToNumber() as defined in Section ToNumber of the ECMAScript Language Specification. This function potentially runs JS code if the passed-in value is an object.

title: napi_coerce_to_object
description: This API implements the abstract operation ToObject() as defined in Section ToObject of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_coerce_to_string
description: This API implements the abstract operation ToString() as defined in Section ToString of the ECMAScript Language Specification. This function potentially runs JS code if the passed-in value is an object.

title: napi_typeof
description: This API represents behavior similar to invoking the typeof Operator on the object as defined in Section typeof operator of the ECMAScript Language Specification. However, there are some differences:

title: napi_instanceof
description: This API represents invoking the instanceof Operator on the object as defined in Section instanceof operator of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_is_array
description: This API represents invoking the IsArray operation on the object as defined in Section IsArray of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_is_arraybuffer
description: This API checks if the Object passed in is an array buffer.

title: napi_is_buffer
description: This API checks if the Object passed in is a buffer or Uint8Array. napi_is_typedarray should be preferred if the caller needs to check if the value is a Uint8Array.

title: napi_is_date
description: This API checks if the Object passed in is a date.

title: napi_is_typedarray
description: This API checks if the Object passed in is a typed array.

title: napi_is_dataview
description: This API checks if the Object passed in is a DataView.

title: napi_strict_equals
description: This API represents the invocation of the Strict Equality algorithm as defined in Section IsStrictlyEqual of the ECMAScript Language Specification.

title: napi_detach_arraybuffer
description: Generally, an ArrayBuffer is non-detachable if it has been detached before. The engine may impose additional conditions on whether an ArrayBuffer is detachable.

title: napi_is_detached_arraybuffer
description: The ArrayBuffer is considered detached if its internal data is null.

title: node_api_is_sharedarraybuffer
description: This API checks if the Object passed in is a SharedArrayBuffer.

title: node_api_create_sharedarraybuffer
description: This API returns a Node-API value corresponding to a JavaScript SharedArrayBuffer. SharedArrayBuffers are used to represent fixed-length binary data buffers that can be shared across multiple workers.

title: napi_property_attributes
description: napi_property_attributes are bit flags used to control the behavior of properties set on a JavaScript object.

title: napi_get_property_names
description: This API returns the names of the enumerable properties of object as an array of strings. The properties of object whose key is a symbol will not be included.

title: napi_get_all_property_names
description: This API returns an array containing the names of the available properties of this object.

title: napi_set_property
description: This API set a property on the Object passed in.

title: napi_get_property
description: This API gets the requested property from the Object passed in.

title: napi_has_property
description: This API checks if the Object passed in has the named property.

title: napi_delete_property
description: This API attempts to delete the key own property from object.

title: napi_has_own_property
description: This API checks if the Object passed in has the named own property. key must be a string or a symbol, or an error will be thrown. Node-API will not perform any conversion between data types.

title: napi_set_named_property
description: This method is equivalent to calling napi_set_property with a napi_value created from the string passed in as utf8Name.

title: napi_get_named_property
description: This method is equivalent to calling napi_get_property with a napi_value created from the string passed in as utf8Name.

title: napi_has_named_property
description: This method is equivalent to calling napi_has_property with a napi_value created from the string passed in as utf8Name.

title: napi_set_element
description: This API sets an element on the Object passed in.

title: napi_get_element
description: This API gets the element at the requested index.

title: napi_has_element
description: This API returns if the Object passed in has an element at the requested index.

title: napi_delete_element
description: This API attempts to delete the specified index from object.

title: napi_define_properties
description: This method allows the efficient definition of multiple properties on a given object. The properties are defined using property descriptors (see napi_property_descriptor).

title: napi_object_freeze
description: This method freezes a given object. This prevents new properties from being added to it, existing properties from being removed, prevents changing the enumerability, configurability, or writability of existing…

title: napi_object_seal
description: This method seals a given object. This prevents new properties from being added to it, as well as marking all existing properties as non-configurable. This is described in Section 19.1.2.20 of the ECMA-262 specification.

title: node_api_set_prototype
description: This API sets the prototype of the Object passed in.

title: napi_call_function
description: This method allows a JavaScript function object to be called from a native add-on. This is the primary mechanism of calling back _from_ the add-on's native code _into_ JavaScript.

title: napi_create_function
description: This API allows an add-on author to create a function object in native code. This is the primary mechanism to allow calling _into_ the add-on's native code _from_ JavaScript.

title: napi_get_cb_info
description: This method is used within a callback function to retrieve details about the call like the arguments and the this pointer from a given callback info.

title: napi_get_new_target
description: This API returns the new.target of the constructor call. If the current callback is not a constructor call, the result is NULL.

title: napi_new_instance
description: This method is used to instantiate a new JavaScript value using a given napi_value that represents the constructor for the object. For example, consider the following snippet:

title: napi_define_class
description: Defines a JavaScript class, including:

title: napi_wrap
description: Wraps a native instance in a JavaScript object. The native instance can be retrieved later using napi_unwrap().

title: napi_unwrap
description: Retrieves a native instance that was previously wrapped in a JavaScript object using napi_wrap().

title: napi_remove_wrap
description: Retrieves a native instance that was previously wrapped in the JavaScript object js_object using napi_wrap() and removes the wrapping.

title: napi_type_tag_object
description: Associates the value of the type_tag pointer with the JavaScript object or external.

title: napi_check_object_type_tag
description: Compares the pointer given as type_tag with any that can be found on js_object. If no tag is found on js_object or, if a tag is found but it does not match type_tag, then result is set to false.

title: napi_add_finalizer
description: Adds a napi_finalize callback which will be called when the JavaScript object in js_object has been garbage-collected.

title: node_api_post_finalizer
description: Schedules a napi_finalize callback to be called asynchronously in the event loop.

title: napi_create_async_work
description: This API allocates a work object that is used to execute logic asynchronously. It should be freed using napi_delete_async_work once the work is no longer required.

title: napi_delete_async_work
description: This API frees a previously allocated work object.

title: napi_queue_async_work
description: This API requests that the previously allocated work be scheduled for execution. Once it returns successfully, this API must not be called again with the same napi_async_work item or the result will be undefined.

title: napi_cancel_async_work
description: This API cancels queued work if it has not yet been started. If it has already started executing, it cannot be cancelled and napi_generic_failure will be returned.

title: napi_async_init
description: In order to retain ABI compatibility with previous versions, passing NULL for async_resource does not result in an error.

title: napi_async_destroy
description: This API can be called even if there is a pending JavaScript exception.

title: napi_make_callback
description: This method allows a JavaScript function object to be called from a native add-on. This API is similar to napi_call_function.

title: napi_open_callback_scope
description: There are cases (for example, resolving promises) where it is necessary to have the equivalent of the scope associated with a callback in place when making certain Node-API calls.

title: napi_close_callback_scope
description: This API can be called even if there is a pending JavaScript exception.

title: napi_get_node_version
description: This function fills the version struct with the major, minor, and patch version of Node.js that is currently running, and the release field with the value of process.release.name.

title: napi_get_version
description: This API returns the highest Node-API version supported by the Node.js runtime. Node-API is planned to be additive such that newer releases of Node.js may support additional API functions.

title: napi_adjust_external_memory
description: This function gives the runtime an indication of the amount of externally allocated memory that is kept alive by JavaScript objects (i.e. a JavaScript object that points to its own memory allocated by a native addon).

title: napi_create_promise
description: This API creates a deferred object and a JavaScript promise.

title: napi_resolve_deferred
description: This API resolves a JavaScript promise by way of the deferred object with which it is associated. Thus, it can only be used to resolve JavaScript promises for which the corresponding deferred object is available.

title: napi_reject_deferred
description: This API rejects a JavaScript promise by way of the deferred object with which it is associated. Thus, it can only be used to reject JavaScript promises for which the corresponding deferred object is available.

title: napi_run_script

title: napi_get_uv_event_loop
description: Note: While libuv only guarantees ABI stability in a major version, its use may result in an addon that does not work across Node.js major versions.

title: napi_get_threadsafe_function_context
description: This API may be called from any thread which makes use of func.

title: napi_call_threadsafe_function
description: This API should not be called with napi_tsfn_blocking from a JavaScript thread, because, if the queue is full, it may cause the JavaScript thread to deadlock.

title: napi_acquire_threadsafe_function
description: A thread should call this API before passing func to any other thread-safe function APIs to indicate that it will be making use of func.

title: napi_release_threadsafe_function
description: A thread should call this API when it stops making use of func. Passing func to any thread-safe APIs after having called this API has undefined results, as func may have been destroyed.

title: napi_ref_threadsafe_function
description: This API is used to indicate that the event loop running on the main thread should not exit until func has been destroyed. Similar to uv_ref it is also idempotent.

title: napi_unref_threadsafe_function
description: This API is used to indicate that the event loop running on the main thread may exit before func is destroyed. Similar to uv_unref it is also idempotent.

title: node_api_get_module_file_name
description: result may be an empty string if the add-on loading process fails to establish the add-on's file name during loading.
